subject: How to use ggplot analyze Spatial time series data?

messages.author: 8e787c860a1558f3
messages.subject: How to use ggplot analyze Spatial time series data?
parts:
Hello,

I have spatial time series data. The data is collected monthly in several fixed locations in an region, for example a province. We want to see whether there are some patterns related to location ( e.g. clustering)  or time ( e.g. seasonality, trend) or their combination. 

I know there are some packages such (sp, maptools) that can visualize the data in map. But it seems to take long time to proceed data into the format required by the these packages. 

Also, is there any good analytic model to analyze this type of model?

Biao
